description: Header file defining internal structures and functions for string formatting arguments in the Abseil C++ library, including type traits, conversion functions, and argument handling classes.

classes.name: FormatArgImpl
classes.description: Type-erased handle to a format argument, managing storage, type conversion, and dispatching for formatting.

classes.name: FormatCountCapture
classes.description: Class used to capture and store the count of formatted output characters.

classes.name: FormatSink
classes.description: Interface for output sink used during formatting.

methods.name: FormatConvertImpl
methods.description: Template function for converting various argument types to formatted output, with specializations for strings, floats, integers, enums, and user-defined conversions.

methods.name: FormatArgImpl
methods.description: Type-erased argument wrapper that manages storage, type traits, and dispatch for formatting arguments.
